text:
sara: Heads up — Acme reporting missing spans in Trace panel. Request links from request-id -> trace view return 'No trace found'. example request_id: req_abc123. Can someone look?

tiago: Which env and timeframe?

sara: prod-us-west, around 03:10-03:20 UTC. Customer attached logs showing span events for the same request_id.

james: I tried reproducing quickly — UI search for request_id:req_abc123 returns empty. Logs show span events though.

eve: Filing an incident and starting repro. INC-2026 created.

eve: Repro steps I'm using:
1) curl -H "X-Request-ID: req_abc123" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'
2) check LogStream: filter request_id:req_abc123 -> spans and span_end entries present
3) Console -> Observability -> Traces -> search request_id:req_abc123 -> "No trace found"

tiago: I ran a quick DB lookup: SELECT trace_id FROM spans WHERE request_id = 'req_abc123' LIMIT 1; -> returns trace_77a. So spans exist in the span DB/index.

james: That points to a UI/indexing mismatch. Noticed frontend PR #4321 renamed some header keys to camelCase; could be we changed the join key from request_id to requestId somewhere.

infra-bot: deployment 2026-03-12T03:00:00Z frontend v4.12.0 deployed to prod-us-west

tiago: Checking ingestion logs around 03:00: saw warnings:
```
[ingest] WARN missing field 'request_id' for span_id=span_987
[ingest] WARN mapping mismatch: expected 'request_id' of type keyword, got null
```

sara: Customer impact estimate?

eve: Preliminary: ~0.4-0.6% of traces in that 30m window had broken links — customers see trace panel unable to find trace by request id.

james: Quick mitigation: UI fallback to query spans by log_request_id and trace_id prefix; deployment possible within 2 hours. Also can run reindex job for missing documents.

infra-bot: Starting hotfix on ingestion pipeline: rolling 2026-03-12T04:05:00Z -> ingest-hotfix v1.1.

tiago: After hotfix, re-run SELECT trace_id FROM spans WHERE request_id = 'req_abc123' -> trace_77a returned and Console lookup shows trace. Patch validated on spot-check.

sara: Notifying customer with short update and ETA for full RCA.

eve: Customer update sent: "we deployed a hotfix, working on reindex and root cause, will follow up with RCA" :thumbsup:

james: Root cause summary draft: schema/join-key mismatch introduced by frontend rename (camelCase) + ingestion validation rejecting spans missing 'request_id' field. Some spans had header normalized as 'req-id' by older SDKs so they were dropped during stricter validation.

sara: Action items:
- tiago/infra: run reindex for 03:00-03:30 window and confirm surface links fixed (in progress)
- devex: publish SDK patch to normalize X-Request-ID header (sara)
- ui: add fallback lookup logic (james)
- support: identify impacted customers and send follow-up RCA (eve)

eve: I'll coordinate postmortem and add timeline to INC-2026.

james: Will open a follow-up PR to add defensive checks in UI.

sara: Thanks all. Please ping here when reindex done so I can close loop with customer. :white_check_mark:
